svg.title: Optimization · a fixed ruler, an honest history
svg.desc: One benchmark · one score · comparable conditions. Clarify is reviewed once as a whole. Loop repeats implementation and checks. Handoff is reviewed by the human. Diagram is schematic, not measured case data.
